faqs.q: Can we stay open while you remodel our business?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. We stage the work in phases, schedule around your operating hours and use dust-control and protection systems so your business keeps running during the remodel.

faqs.q: How long does a typical remodel take?
faqs.a: A complete remodel of a home or commercial unit usually takes 2 to 6 weeks depending on scope. A minor renovation such as drywall or painting can take 1 to 2 days. We define a clear schedule before starting.

faqs.q: Do remodels include electrical and plumbing changes?
faqs.a: Yes. We coordinate all trades in-house, including electrical redistribution, plumbing adjustments and finishes, so you deal with a single contractor and a single warranty.
